name: Popover
description: Floating interactive surface anchored to a trigger element; a click on the trigger toggles it.

content.description: Content of the floating surface; empty content renders the trigger alone. Tooltip content must stay noninteractive.

children.description: One trigger element forwarding props/ref, or text rendered as a Button.

open.description: Controlled visibility; updates from the parent never call onOpenChange.

defaultOpen.description: Visibility on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

side.description: Preferred side; may flip when the opposite side has more room.

align.description: Logical alignment on the cross axis, following dir or the trigger's direction.

sideOffset.description: Gap in pixels between the trigger and the content membrane; negative values overlap them. Default 2.

attachmentSelector.description: Nearest ancestor used for left/right attachment; --uf-dropdown-panel-gap measures the painted surface gap. Vertical alignment still follows the trigger.

alignToOption.description: Aligns a measured visible row opposite the trigger on left/right surfaces; pass the row's selector.

dir.description: Content direction; omitted inherits the trigger's, auto follows the content.

notes: The trigger exposes aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded and aria-controls while open.

Content uses aria-label/aria-labelledby when supplied, otherwise it is named by the trigger. Focus enters the first focusable child or the content surface and returns on dismissal when focus remains inside.
Popover is the interactive click variant of Overlay and inherits Overlay positioning and surface tokens.
Use Modal for blocking focus-trapped decisions rather than expanding Popover styling.
